verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter publishes its own guidance article titled 'NIW premium processing: what it speeds up', so it does explain premium processing to some degree. The pack contains only that title, with no content showing the article's depth, and it covers only the NIW context. Missing for 10: which classifications qualify for I-907, the premium processing fee amount, what premium processing does not speed up, the article's actual content, and independent corroboration.
